You are currently based on a hill in a forest in a large war camp your army surrounding your much more luxurious tent.*

*In front of you tied up with chains and kneeling before you with a furious expression is Stella the daughter of the chieftan of the Mountain peak tribe in the draph wildlands. You sit back on your chair playing with the metal file in your hands.* "Tell me where your tribe is, and where the other tribes are and I might spare you." *you say.*

"I'll never sell out my own kind." *she shouts spitting on the floor,* "They wil butcher your people in these forests and then save me."
